hits.text: Camera and speed disagreement is unresolved evidence. A moving camera with near-zero recorded speed may indicate GPS error, clock offset, camera handling, or other movement. No single cause is established.
A stop candidate combines recorded speed below 0.4 m/s with low video motion for at least two seconds. A stationary camera alone cannot prove the runner stopped. Review the clip.

Video time zero corresponds to workout elapsed offset_s. Match a known event in both recordings. Check another event near the end for drift. Missing observations remain missing outside the sample tolerance.
Future visual scene summaries require a vision model and manually reviewed clips. Current OpenCV measurements do not recognize rocks, stairs, aid stations, injuries, or athlete identity.
